title: Woman Gets Caught Trying to Destroy Drugs in Back of Police Car
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On October 28, 2023, a sergeant was on patrol when he observed a vehicle with expired registration in Lewiston, WI. As the vehicle pulled over, the driver made several movements, shuffling items around. During an attempt to search the driver, she exhibited nervous behavior, resisted, and subsequently met the ground. When placed in the backseat of the police car, she continued to make persistent movements, indicating an effort to destroy evidence. A spilled bag of unknown drugs was soon discovered, which raised major concerns about potential fentanyl exposure to the sergeant and his K9 partner.

Our featured content aims to depict law enforcement interactions, emphasizing education over public shaming or ridicule. In a world filled with misleading conversations about law enforcement, it's crucial to present these interactions within their contexts to inform and educate the public.
